name: Snapmaker U1 overlay for go2rtc
info:
Writes the status line for the U1 camera in UniFi Protect to /overlay/status.txt.
go2rtc's ffmpeg re-reads that file once a second and draws it on the video.
Settings (printer address and name) are in the "Every 10 s" node.
Each write goes to a temp file that is renamed into place, because ffmpeg stops the stream if the file is missing.
